title: UnexpectedValueException: Storage for mysqli::get_server_info is not user-defined
body:
This is similar to https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/issues/884 and https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/issues/963:
```
↪ git remote -v
upstream	git@github.com:doctrine/dbal.git (fetch)
upstream	git@github.com:doctrine/dbal.git (push)

↪ git rev-parse HEAD # develop
e5a586eaba90ff5df55c6c65369e8fdf000b6804

↪ vendor/bin/psalm --version
Psalm 2.0.14@792144def40d678b7fa7c8a52da6cdbd34dd415a

↪ vendor/bin/psalm --debug-by-line
...
lib/Doctrine/DBAL/Driver/Mysqli/MysqliConnection.php:107

Fatal error: Uncaught UnexpectedValueException: Storage for mysqli::get_server_info is not user-defined in vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Codebase/Methods.php:551
Stack trace:
#0 vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Checker/Statements/Expression/Call/MethodCallChecker.php(681): Psalm\Codebase\Methods->getUserMethodStorage('mysqli::get_ser...')
#1 vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Checker/Statements/ExpressionChecker.php(105): Psalm\Checker\Statements\Expression\Call\MethodCallChecker::analyze(Object(Psalm\Checker\StatementsChecker), Object(PhpParser\Node\Expr\MethodCall), Object(Psalm\Context))
#2 vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Checker/Statements/Expression/AssignmentChecker.php(144): Psalm\Checker\Statements\ExpressionChecker::analyze(Object(Psalm\Checker\StatementsChecker), Object(PhpParser\Node\Expr\MethodCall), Object(Psalm\Context))
#3 vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Checker/Statements/ExpressionChe in vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Codebase/Methods.php on line 551
```
The [line in question](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/blob/e5a586eaba90ff5df55c6c65369e8fdf000b6804/lib/Doctrine/DBAL/Driver/Mysqli/MysqliConnection.php#L107) contains:
```php
$serverInfos = $this->conn->get_server_info();
```
Where `$this->conn` is of type `mysqli`.
